title: Delegation Resolver
prompt: Write `resolveAction(event, root)` for a plain-object event model. `event` is `{ target }` and elements are objects with `matches(sel)` and a `parent` chain ending in `null`. RETURN the first element from `target` walking up (including `root` itself? no — stop before `root`) that `matches("[data-action]")`; RETURN `null` when none matches before reaching `root`.

tests.name: finds the nearest data-action ancestor
tests.hint: Walk from event.target up through .parent, stopping when el === root.

tests.name: returns null when the click misses every action
tests.hint: After the walk ends without a match, return null.

tests.name: works when the target itself is actionable
tests.hint: The walk starts at target — check it before climbing.
